claims.summary: Microwave electromagnetic radiation causes rapid electrical arcing in phone metal components, destroying the device and risking catastrophic explosion.
claims.why_this_result: Microwaves oscillate dipole water molecules at 2.45 GHz; metal conductors inside batteries spark violently under these fields.

trigger_keywords: forward to 20 contacts to keep whatsapp free
claims.summary: This is a recurring 15-year chain letter hoax; Meta/WhatsApp operates over IP data connections and never conditions service on forwarded chain messages.
claims.why_this_result: Official WhatsApp security documentation states account status is never altered by messaging chains or viral forwarding.
